target: The Supreme Court struck down President Trump's sweeping tariffs on February 20, 2026, ruling 6-3 that he exceeded his emergency economic powers. Trump has since pledged to reimpose equivalent tariffs at an even higher rate through alternative legal mechanisms. Analyze what this moment reveals about the structural relationship between executive power, economic policy, democratic legitimacy, and institutional resiliency in the United States of America.

The moment highlights persistent conflicts between executive initiative and constitutional constraints in trade policy.
